segments.identification_and_sources: 18068 (13). 18255 (14). 18256 (15). Bull. tr. hist. 1911, 99 (16) ; ib. 100 (17); 1919, 85 (18). D. 9097 (19), Thamugadensibus VIII 17870 (= D. 446) (20). 17871 (21), Cirtensi VIII 19495 (22), Arsacalitano VIII 6048 (23), Cuiculitanis Bull. tr. hist. 1916, 233 (24) ; ib. 1911, 115 (25), Suburburano ib. 1917, 342 (26), Mauretano VIII 8796 cf. 18021 (27); ad eum pertinere videtur frustulum Lambaesitanum VIII 18078 (28) ; incertum num eius nomen recte restituatur in t. Nomina plena extant sive recte restituta sunt in titulis omnibus.
segments.offices_and_career: Clarissimus vir... Consul designatus t. 3—9. 10. 29 (si hic t. ad eum pertinet) a. 198 t. 8 (nomina consulum anni 197, quae leguntur in t. 4, non ad tituli dedicationem sed ad collationem pecuniae spectare videntur; cf. Stout Governors of Moes. 36 sq.); consularis t. 17. 19 (a. 200), vir amp(lissimus) consularis a. 199 t. 25 (ubi Severus errore dicitur cos. III). Faustus cum consul designatus fuerit a. 198, eodem anno fasces in legatione Numidica gesserit necesse est; itaque in t. 11. 13. 21 (posito a. 199) non co(n)s(ul) sed co(n)s(ularis) amplissimus legendum (item co(n)s(ularis) in t. 1 a. b. 2 b.). Severus in sortitione proconsulatus (Africae vel Asiae) eum praeteriit Dio 78, 22, 4 (Dionem errasse et Antoninum intelligendum esse statuit Waddington Fast. As. n. 169 sine idonea causa). A. 217 Macrinus eum in locum (C. Iulii) Aspri proconsulem in Asiam misit et, cum exiguum anni proconsularis spatium ei remaneret, mandavit, ut Aufidii Frontonis loco etiam in annum sequentem (218/219) provinciae praeesset Dio 78, 22, 2. 4. Quod num Elagabalus ratum habuerit, ignoramus.
segments.governorship_attestation: Legatus Augusti vel Augustorum pro praetore (Numidiae) t. 1—29 anno 196 vel priore semestri a. 197 (cum Caracalla Caesar dictus sit, nondum imperator destinatus) t. 22, a. 197 t. 15. 20. 23, a. 199 t. 21. 24. 25. 26, a. 200 t. 19, a. 201 t. 1 a. b. 2 a. b. (de t. 4 v. infra). Legatus Augustorum pro pr. (Moesiae superioris) intra a. 202 et 207 t. 30 (numeri annorum tribuniciae potestatis corrupti sunt). 31.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Pater fortasse Sex. Anicii Fausti, qui dicitur in t. Thamugadensi VIII 17890 Anici consularis filius. Anicii, qui aetate labente floruerunt, ab eo originem duxisse videntur.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: The text discusses the chronology of his governorship in Numidia, arguing that since he was consul designatus in 198, he must have held the fasces in Numidia in that same year. It also notes the error in Dio regarding the proconsulship of Asia under Macrinus, and discusses the debate over whether Severus or Antoninus passed him over in the sortition.
segments.bibliography_or_cross_references: cf. Pallu de Lessert Fast. 1, 406—417; Stout Governors of Moes. 36 sq.; Waddington Fast. As. n. 169; cf. sub Anicio Fausto Paulino.

problems.issue: Province normalized as 'Numidia' is correct, but the registry label should be 'Numidia' (not 'Africa proconsularis' or other variants). Confirmed from text: 'Legatus Augusti vel Augustorum pro praetore (Numidiae)'

The date range for the Numidia governorship is given as 196-197, but the text explicitly states the governorship continued until 201 (e.g., 'a. 201 t. 1 a. b.'). The end date should be extended to 201.

The proconsulship of Asia (gov_3) is not explicitly attested for Sex. Anicius Faustus in the visible text. The text states Macrinus sent him to replace Asprus, but it is unclear if Elagabalus ratified this appointment ('Quod num Elagabalus ratum habuerit, ignoramus'). This introduces uncertainty about whether he actually held the office.
problems.suggested_fix: Remove gov_3 or mark certainty as 'low' and add a note about the uncertainty of Elagabalus' ratification.
